faq.a: An IP address is a numerical identifier used to route traffic between devices on an internet protocol network.

faq.q: Can IP geolocation identify a person?
faq.a: No. IP geolocation estimates a network connection's location and is not a precise way to identify a person or a street address.
IP lookups are not stored in a site database. The optional history tool saves entries only in this browser's local storage.

legal.intro: Last updated: 1 June 2026. This page explains how IPAnalyzer Pro is designed to handle information when you use the service.

privacySections.title: Information and IP lookups
privacySections.body: IP addresses entered for analysis are sent to third-party GeoIP or DNS providers to return the requested result. We do not store lookup queries in a site database or associate them with a user profile. Providers may process request metadata under their own privacy policies.

privacySections.title: Local history and your choices
privacySections.body: If you use IP History, entries are stored in localStorage in this browser on your device. They are not transmitted to our server. Clear individual entries or the complete history in the tool, or clear browser storage at any time.

privacySections.title: Contact messages
privacySections.body: The contact form opens your default email application to deliver a message to the configured contact address. No message is stored by this site through that form. Your email provider processes the message under its own terms.

privacySections.title: Cookies, analytics and third parties
privacySections.body: The core tools do not require advertising cookies or account cookies. If optional analytics are enabled by the operator, they should be configured with appropriate consent and data minimization. External map tiles and data providers receive network requests when their features are used.

privacySections.title: GDPR rights and security
privacySections.body: Where GDPR applies, you may have rights to access, correct, erase, restrict or object to processing, and to complain to a supervisory authority. Since this service does not keep lookup history, a query may not be identifiable by us. Contact the site operator for privacy requests. We use reasonable safeguards but cannot guarantee the security of third-party services or the public internet.

termsSections.title: Using the service
termsSections.body: You may use IPAnalyzer Pro for lawful learning, administration and troubleshooting. You are responsible for ensuring you have authority to query, scan or otherwise test a network. Do not use the tools to disrupt, access or surveil systems without permission.

termsSections.title: Acceptable use and availability
termsSections.body: Do not attempt to bypass limits, interfere with the service, or use it in violation of applicable law. Features and third-party data may change or become unavailable without notice. Results are provided for informational purposes and may be incomplete or delayed.

termsSections.title: Intellectual property
termsSections.body: The site design, text and original materials are protected by applicable intellectual-property laws. You may link to the service and use results responsibly; no ownership of third-party data is claimed.

termsSections.title: Disclaimer and liability
termsSections.body: The service is provided as available, without warranties to the extent permitted by law. We are not liable for indirect loss, inaccurate data, network interruption, or actions taken in reliance on a result. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot legally be excluded.

termsSections.title: Changes and contact
termsSections.body: We may update these terms as the service evolves. Continued use after an update means the new terms apply where legally permitted. Contact the site operator through the Contact page with questions.

disclaimerSections.title: Informational estimates
disclaimerSections.body: IP location, ownership, reputation and security classifications are derived from external data and heuristics. They can be inaccurate, stale, incomplete or affected by VPNs, mobile networks, proxies and shared infrastructure. A map marker is not a person's precise location.

disclaimerSections.title: No security guarantee
disclaimerSections.body: A clean or unknown result does not prove that an address is safe, and a warning does not prove malicious activity. Use multiple trusted sources and your own security procedures before making decisions.

disclaimerSections.title: Authorized testing only
disclaimerSections.body: Port and network checks are intended only for systems you own or are explicitly authorized to assess. Laws and network policies differ by location. You are solely responsible for your use of the tools.

disclaimerSections.title: Third-party services
disclaimerSections.body: Lookup, DNS and map features may rely on external providers. IPAnalyzer Pro does not control their availability, accuracy, retention practices or terms.

cookiesSections.title: What cookies are used
cookiesSections.body: The core experience is designed not to require advertising or tracking cookies. Browser localStorage is used only when you choose to save IP History; localStorage is not a cookie and remains on your device.

cookiesSections.title: External content
cookiesSections.body: The map feature loads map tiles from an external tile provider. That provider receives the browser's network request and may set or process data according to its own policy. Blocking external content may affect the map.

cookiesSections.title: Your controls
cookiesSections.body: You can clear local history through the tool or remove site storage in your browser settings. If optional analytics are added by an operator, they should be disclosed and consent managed as required by your jurisdiction.
